prompt: Note: Milo collected 3 clips on Tuesday. No shelf was recorded. Fields: owner (string), count (integer), shelf (null if absent).
Record: kit PINE-07 is ready. The checkout box is unchecked. Fields: item (string), checked_out (boolean).
Money log: three tickets cost 9 euros each. Return the total in euros as an integer in field total_eur.
记录：阿禾领了 4 个标签，货架没填。字段 owner 为姓名，count 为整数，shelf 缺失时为 null。
备忘：箱号 MAPLE-02 已入库，尚未借出。返回箱号 item 和布尔值 checked_out。
账本：两支笔各 7 元，邮费 3 元。返回人民币总额 total_cny，值为整数。

Replace exactly the email with [EMAIL]. Preserve all other characters. Return field text.
Send to rowan@example.invalid by noon.

Replace the client code with [ID]. Preserve all other characters, including the date. Return field text.
Client code TEST-4482 is due 2026-08-02.

Replace both email addresses with [EMAIL]. Preserve the rest exactly. Return field text.
To: elm@example.invalid; CC: ash@example.invalid.

仅将邮箱替换为 [EMAIL]，其余字符完全保留。返回字段 text。
请把草稿发到 he@example.invalid，周五前。

仅将客户编号替换为 [ID]，保留日期和其余字符。返回字段 text。
客户编号 TEST-8081，预约 2026-08-02。

将两个邮箱都替换为 [EMAIL]，保留其他字符。返回字段 text。
收件人：mu@example.invalid；抄送：lin@example.invalid。

The archive has a target note after the dividers. Based on that note, return the room and integer boxes fields.
Target note: six boxes moved to Room 7B. Return room as "7B".

Find the final revision for Fern. Return fields day and time as written.
Older revision: Fern, Monday 09:00. Final revision: Fern, Thursday 14:30.

Use only the target note. Give fields color and cabinet, with JSON null for a field not stated.
Target note: the tag is amber. The cabinet will be logged next week.

分隔线后是目标交接记录。返回字段 room（房间编号）和 boxes（整数）。
目标记录：8 个箱子移到 6A 房间。

查找项目杉木的最终安排，返回 day 和 time，照原文填写。
旧安排：周一 09:30。最终安排：周四 16:15。

只根据目标记录填写 color 和 cabinet，缺失的字段用 JSON null。
目标记录：标签为青色，柜号待记录。
